example_en: The new tax laws could trigger a decline in consumer spending.
example_uz: Yangi soliq qonunlari iste'mol xarajatlarining pasayishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

example_en: Stress is often what triggers his headaches.
example_uz: Stress ko'pincha uning bosh og'rig'iga sabab bo'ladi.

example_en: While some people prefer cities, others find peace in the countryside.
example_uz: Ba'zi odamlar shaharlarni afzal ko'rishsa, boshqalari qishloqda tinchlik topadi.

example_en: While the cost is high, the quality is definitely worth it.
example_uz: Narxi yuqori bo'lsa-da, sifati, albatta, bunga arziydi.

example_en: Since it's raining, we should stay indoors.
example_uz: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgani uchun biz uyda qolishimiz kerak.

example_en: Since I have no cash, can I pay by card?
example_uz: Menda naqd pul yo'qligi sababli, karta orqali to'lay olamanmi?

example_en: The price of the tour is fifty dollars, including lunch.
example_uz: Sayohat narxi tushlik bilan birga ellik dollar.

example_en: Everyone in my family, including my grandfather, loves football.
example_uz: Mening oilamdagi hamma, jumladan, bobom ham futbolni yaxshi ko'radi.

example_en: Although it was raining heavily, we decided to go for a walk in the park.
example_uz: Yomg'ir kuchli bo'lsa-da, biz parkda sayr qilishga qaror qildik.

example_en: I managed to pass the English exam, although I didn't study very hard for it.
example_uz: Men ingliz tili imtihonidan o'tishga muvaffaq bo'ldim, garchi men bu imtihon uchun juda ko'p o'qimaganman.

example_en: Unlike my brother, I prefer staying indoors on weekends.
example_uz: Akamdan farqli o'laroq, men dam olish kunlari uyda qolishni afzal ko'raman.

example_en: Unlike many other applicants, she had significant practical experience.
example_uz: Boshqa ko'plab abituriyentlardan farqli o'laroq, u katta amaliy tajribaga ega edi.

example_en: The hotel is centrally located; furthermore, the prices are very reasonable.
example_uz: Mehmonxona markazda joylashgan; bundan tashqari, narxlar juda mos keladi.

example_en: Pollution is harming the planet. Furthermore, it threatens our future.
example_uz: Ifloslanish sayyoraga zarar etkazmoqda. Bundan tashqari, bu bizning kelajagimizga tahdid soladi.

example_en: The company failed to innovate; consequently, it lost its market share.
example_uz: Kompaniya innovatsiyalarni amalga oshira olmadi; natijada u bozordagi ulushini yo'qotdi.

example_en: Heavy rain caused flooding; consequently, the event was cancelled.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir suv toshqini keltirib chiqardi; shuning uchun tadbir bekor qilindi.
